  "dependency_coverage": [
    {"id":"D001","name":"NumStability.IsLinearAdvectionSolution","interpretation":"The pointwise advection predicate holds at every real space-time point.","effect_on_target":"Requires global classical solutionhood of the actual invariant and characterizes classical translated profiles.","source_match":"Matches the real space-time PDE under the recorded classical interpretation.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D002","name":"NumStability.IsRectangleConservationLawSolution","interpretation":"Every spatial slice and temporal boundary flux is interval integrable; change in spatial integral equals integrated left-boundary flux minus right-boundary flux on every rectangle.","effect_on_target":"Defines the precise integral solution notion for profiles with flux state ↦ -c*state.","source_match":"Matches the coordinator-selected rectangle interpretation, consistent with the sign in (1.10); this definition is not explicitly printed in the selected sentence.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D003","name":"NumStability.LinearAcousticsSolution","interpretation":"A parameter-indexed bundle whose constructor D009 supplies nonzero density, two fields, and their global acoustic equations.","effect_on_target":"Retains the coupled acoustic-system premise.","source_match":"Represents the system (1.5) under the selected classical interpretation.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D004","name":"NumStability.LinearAcousticsSolution.pressure","interpretation":"Projects the second bundle field, the pressure function supplied to D009.","effect_on_target":"Uses the actual system pressure in the invariant.","source_match":"Matches p in (1.5) and the definition of w².","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D005","name":"NumStability.LinearAcousticsSolution.velocity","interpretation":"Projects the third bundle field, the velocity function supplied to D009.","effect_on_target":"Uses the actual system velocity in the invariant.","source_match":"Matches particle velocity u in (1.5).","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D006","name":"NumStability.linearAcousticsLeftInvariant","interpretation":"The field (x,t) ↦ pressure(x,t) - density*soundSpeed*velocity(x,t).","effect_on_target":"Constructs p-rho*c*u with c determined by the material parameters.","source_match":"Exactly matches the displayed w² definition.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D007","name":"NumStability.travelingWave","interpretation":"The field (x,t) ↦ profile(x-speed*t).","effect_on_target":"At speed -c this is profile(x+c*t), constant along x=x0-c*t.","source_match":"Matches the printed q² family and its leftward direction, with the w²/q² switch recorded separately.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D008","name":"NumStability.IsLinearAdvectionSolutionAt","interpretation":"There exist actual time and space derivatives satisfying qt+speed*qx=0.","effect_on_target":"Enforces derivative existence, rather than an equation involving default values of a total derivative operator.","source_match":"Matches the classical meaning of w²_t-c*w²_x=0 under the selected interpretation.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D009","name":"NumStability.LinearAcousticsSolution.mk","interpretation":"Constructs a bundle from rho≠0, real pressure and velocity fields, and D010 at every x,t.","effect_on_target":"Specifies the full effective domain of the system argument; it imposes no boundary or initial data.","source_match":"Matches (1.5); nonzero density follows from the selected positive physical domain.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D010","name":"NumStability.IsLinearAcousticsSolutionAt","interpretation":"Four partial derivatives exist and satisfy pt+K*ux=0 and ut+rho⁻¹*px=0.","effect_on_target":"Supplies exactly the differential equations needed to derive the invariant equation.","source_match":"Matches both equations of (1.5), with classical partial derivatives.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D011","name":"NumStability.IsLinearAdvectionSolutionAt._proof_1","interpretation":"Continuous scalar multiplication follows from the real normed-space structure.","effect_on_target":"Supplies derivative infrastructure without adding a hypothesis on profiles.","source_match":"Compatible with ordinary real calculus.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D012","name":"NumStability.IsLinearAcousticsSolutionAt._proof_1","interpretation":"Real multiplication, viewed as scalar action, is continuous.","effect_on_target":"Supplies the continuity instance for acoustic partial derivatives.","source_match":"Compatible with the source's real differential equations.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D013","name":"And","interpretation":"Logical conjunction.","effect_on_target":"Requires all stated conclusions and all components of the solution predicates.","source_match":"Preserves the simultaneous PDE and solution-family assertions.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D014","name":"DenselyNormedField.toNontriviallyNormedField","interpretation":"Retains the normed field and derives nontriviality of its norm.","effect_on_target":"Provides the real scalar structure for differentiability.","source_match":"No change to real calculus or the source domain.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D015","name":"Differentiable","interpretation":"Differentiability at every point of the domain.","effect_on_target":"Requires the profile to be differentiable everywhere, without requiring a continuous derivative.","source_match":"Matches the coordinator-selected differentiable-profile class; no such exact class is claimed to be printed.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D016","name":"DivInvMonoid.toDiv","interpretation":"Projects division from the supplied division-inverse structure.","effect_on_target":"Selects real division in K/rho.","source_match":"Matches the sound-speed ratio.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D017","name":"Eq","interpretation":"Exact equality of two objects of the same type.","effect_on_target":"Makes the PDE balances, translations, and integral balances exact.","source_match":"Matches the displayed exact equations.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D018","name":"HAdd.hAdd","interpretation":"Projects the selected addition operation.","effect_on_target":"Uses real addition in x+c*t and the differential balances.","source_match":"Matches source addition.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D019","name":"HDiv.hDiv","interpretation":"Projects the selected division operation.","effect_on_target":"Forms K/rho with real division.","source_match":"Matches c=√(K/rho).","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D020","name":"HMul.hMul","interpretation":"Projects the selected multiplication operation.","effect_on_target":"Forms rho*c*u, c*t, and the linear flux.","source_match":"Matches the source coefficients and products.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D021","name":"HSub.hSub","interpretation":"Projects the selected subtraction operation.","effect_on_target":"Forms the invariant, characteristic displacement, and integral differences.","source_match":"Preserves the negative-mode and conservation signs.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D022","name":"Iff","interpretation":"Both implication directions between propositions.","effect_on_target":"States exact classical and rectangle profile domains.","source_match":"Under the selected convention the sufficient directions are the chosen solution classes; necessary directions follow from the definitions at t=0.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D023","name":"InnerProductSpace.toNormedSpace","interpretation":"Projects the normed-space structure of an inner-product space.","effect_on_target":"Instantiates scalar PDE predicates and integration over real values.","source_match":"No additional geometric restriction on the real fields.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D024","name":"IntervalIntegrable","interpretation":"Integrability on both oriented half-open intervals (a,b] and (b,a].","effect_on_target":"Universal a,b expresses local Lebesgue integrability on the real line.","source_match":"Matches the selected locally integrable profile class; it does not require integrability over the whole line.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D025","name":"LT.lt","interpretation":"Projects strict order.","effect_on_target":"Expresses strict positivity of K, rho, and c.","source_match":"Matches the selected positive material domain and inherited positive sound speed.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D026","name":"MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume","interpretation":"Projects the measure from the selected measure-space instance.","effect_on_target":"Uses the same real volume for all spatial and temporal integrals.","source_match":"The native supplement identifies this instance with ordinary length measure, matching dx and dt.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D027","name":"Neg.neg","interpretation":"Projects additive negation.","effect_on_target":"Sets speed and flux coefficient to -c.","source_match":"Matches leftward propagation speed.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D028","name":"NonUnitalSeminormedCommRing.toNonUnitalSeminormedRing","interpretation":"Forgets commutativity while retaining the underlying seminormed ring.","effect_on_target":"Part of the real norm-instance path for differentiability.","source_match":"Preserves ordinary real operations and topology.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D029","name":"NonUnitalSeminormedRing.toSeminormedAddCommGroup","interpretation":"Retains norm, additive group, and pseudometric from the ring.","effect_on_target":"Supplies the additive topological structure for real calculus.","source_match":"Does not alter the source scalar domain.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D030","name":"NormedAddCommGroup.toNormedAddGroup","interpretation":"Retains norm, additive group, and metric while forgetting commutativity.","effect_on_target":"Supports the extended-norm integrability instance.","source_match":"Preserves the ordinary real absolute-value norm.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D031","name":"NormedAddCommGroup.toSeminormedAddCommGroup","interpretation":"Retains norm, addition, and pseudometric while weakening the structure class.","effect_on_target":"Provides normed-space and derivative prerequisites.","source_match":"No weakening of the actual real metric occurs.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D032","name":"NormedAddGroup.toENormedAddMonoid","interpretation":"Builds an extended-norm additive monoid from the existing normed additive group.","effect_on_target":"Makes interval integrability use the norm of real values.","source_match":"Matches absolute integrability in the selected Lebesgue interpretation.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D033","name":"NormedCommRing.toSeminormedCommRing","interpretation":"Retains ring operations, norm, and pseudometric.","effect_on_target":"Connects real ring and calculus instances.","source_match":"No source-domain change.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D034","name":"NormedSpace.toModule","interpretation":"Projects the underlying module.","effect_on_target":"Provides scalar multiplication in derivative definitions.","source_match":"Here the scalar action is ordinary real multiplication.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D035","name":"OfNat.ofNat","interpretation":"Projects a type's interpretation of a natural numeral.","effect_on_target":"Interprets the zero literals as real zero.","source_match":"Matches zero in the homogeneous equations and positivity tests.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D036","name":"PseudoMetricSpace.toUniformSpace","interpretation":"Projects the uniform structure carried by a pseudometric space.","effect_on_target":"Supplies the usual real topology through D056.","source_match":"Matches ordinary real limits and derivatives.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D037","name":"RCLike.toInnerProductSpaceReal","interpretation":"Builds the real inner-product structure from the RCLike scalar algebra and real part of its inner product.","effect_on_target":"For Real, supplies its usual one-dimensional real normed-space structure.","source_match":"Introduces no complex-valued quantities or extra dimensions.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D038","name":"Real","interpretation":"The library real-number type at the external semantic frontier.","effect_on_target":"All coordinates, parameters, field values, and profile values are real.","source_match":"Matches the explicit real setting on printed page 1.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D039","name":"Real.denselyNormedField","interpretation":"The real normed field equipped with density of attainable positive norms.","effect_on_target":"Supplies the scalar calculus instance.","source_match":"Matches ordinary real analysis.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D040","name":"Real.instAdd","interpretation":"The real addition operation.","effect_on_target":"Adds profile arguments and differential terms.","source_match":"Matches printed addition.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D041","name":"Real.instAddCommGroup","interpretation":"The inferred canonical real additive commutative group.","effect_on_target":"Supports real differentiation and additive identities.","source_match":"Matches the real linear system.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D042","name":"Real.instDivInvMonoid","interpretation":"Real multiplication and inverse with division equal to multiplication by inverse.","effect_on_target":"Determines K/rho consistently with rho⁻¹ in the acoustic system.","source_match":"Matches division by positive density.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D043","name":"Real.instLT","interpretation":"The ordinary strict order on real numbers.","effect_on_target":"Enforces K>0 and rho>0 and asserts c>0.","source_match":"Matches the selected physical domain.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D044","name":"Real.instMul","interpretation":"Real multiplication.","effect_on_target":"Determines all coefficients and linear flux products.","source_match":"Matches scalar multiplication in the printed formulas.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D045","name":"Real.instNeg","interpretation":"Real additive inverse.","effect_on_target":"Negates c to obtain the leftward speed.","source_match":"Matches -c.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D046","name":"Real.instRCLike","interpretation":"The real RCLike instance has identity real part, zero imaginary part, and the real normed algebra.","effect_on_target":"Supplies real inner-product and calculus infrastructure.","source_match":"Keeps all quantities real; no complex interpretation is introduced.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D047","name":"Real.instSub","interpretation":"Subtraction defined as addition of the negative.","effect_on_target":"Makes x-(-c)*t equal x+c*t and defines p-rho*c*u.","source_match":"Preserves all selected signs.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D048","name":"Real.instZero","interpretation":"Real zero.","effect_on_target":"The homogeneous PDE right-hand side and positivity reference value.","source_match":"Matches the source zero.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D049","name":"Real.measureSpace","interpretation":"The supplement resolves inferInstance to orthonormal-basis Haar volume on the real Borel space, equal to the identity Stieltjes measure; (a,b] has measure max(b-a,0).","effect_on_target":"Ensures interval integrability and rectangle balances use nonzero ordinary Lebesgue length measure.","source_match":"Matches the selected locally integrable and rectangle-conservation interpretation and the source's spatial integration.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D050","name":"Real.normedAddCommGroup","interpretation":"Real norm and metric combined with its additive group.","effect_on_target":"Fixes the actual normed codomain of PDE and integral predicates.","source_match":"Matches real scalar field values.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D051","name":"Real.normedCommRing","interpretation":"Combines the real additive norm and metric with real commutative ring operations.","effect_on_target":"Supports the real differential structure without altering multiplication.","source_match":"Matches the real constant-coefficient formulas.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D052","name":"Real.normedField","interpretation":"The real field with its usual norm and metric, including totalized inverse at zero.","effect_on_target":"Supplies real calculus and division; density positivity prevents using the zero-inverse convention.","source_match":"Matches ordinary division on the selected domain.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D053","name":"Real.pseudoMetricSpace","interpretation":"Distance is |x-y|.","effect_on_target":"Determines ordinary real neighborhoods for differentiability.","source_match":"Matches the source real topology.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D054","name":"Real.sqrt","interpretation":"Converts to nonnegative reals, applies their square root, and returns a real; negative inputs are truncated before taking the root.","effect_on_target":"At K/rho>0 it is the positive square root; no truncated negative-input case is reachable.","source_match":"Matches c=√(K/rho) under the selected positive material convention.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D055","name":"SeminormedCommRing.toNonUnitalSeminormedCommRing","interpretation":"Retains norm, operations, and pseudometric while forgetting the unit requirement.","effect_on_target":"Provides a real additive norm instance used in calculus.","source_match":"No change to values, topology, or parameter domain.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D056","name":"UniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace","interpretation":"Projects the underlying topology.","effect_on_target":"Uses the topology inherited from ordinary real distance.","source_match":"Matches classical real differentiability.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D057","name":"Zero.toOfNat0","interpretation":"Interprets numeral 0 by the supplied zero.","effect_on_target":"Identifies all real zero literals with real zero.","source_match":"Matches homogeneous equations and strict positivity.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D058","name":"instHAdd","interpretation":"Uses ordinary addition as homogeneous heterogeneous addition.","effect_on_target":"Routes addition notation to real addition.","source_match":"Preserves the printed sums.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D059","name":"instHDiv","interpretation":"Uses ordinary division as homogeneous heterogeneous division.","effect_on_target":"Routes K/rho to the real division instance.","source_match":"Preserves the sound-speed ratio.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D060","name":"instHMul","interpretation":"Uses ordinary multiplication as homogeneous heterogeneous multiplication.","effect_on_target":"Routes products to real multiplication.","source_match":"Preserves all physical coefficients.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D061","name":"instHSub","interpretation":"Uses ordinary subtraction as homogeneous heterogeneous subtraction.","effect_on_target":"Routes differences to the selected real or additive-group subtraction.","source_match":"Preserves invariant and conservation signs.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D062","name":"AddGroup.toSubNegMonoid","interpretation":"Projects the additive group's subtraction and negation structure.","effect_on_target":"Supports subtraction in real-valued interval integrals and derivatives.","source_match":"Matches ordinary additive differences.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D063","name":"NormedAddCommGroup","interpretation":"The external structure of an additive commutative group with a compatible norm and metric.","effect_on_target":"A generic prerequisite instantiated here solely by Real.","source_match":"Does not generalize the target beyond real scalar values.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D064","name":"NormedAddGroup.toAddGroup","interpretation":"Projects the additive group from a normed additive group.","effect_on_target":"Supplies additive inverse and subtraction for integral differences.","source_match":"Matches real subtraction.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D065","name":"NormedSpace","interpretation":"The external structure of a scalar module with compatible norm.","effect_on_target":"Allows the generic predicates to operate on Real over Real.","source_match":"No extra source hypothesis is introduced because the instance is canonical.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D066","name":"SeminormedAddCommGroup.toPseudoMetricSpace","interpretation":"Projects the underlying pseudometric.","effect_on_target":"Connects normed-field values to derivative neighborhoods.","source_match":"Here the metric is the ordinary real metric.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D067","name":"SubNegMonoid.toSub","interpretation":"Projects subtraction.","effect_on_target":"Provides subtraction in the generic integral balance instantiated at Real.","source_match":"Matches final-minus-initial mass and left-minus-right flux.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D068","name":"intervalIntegral","interpretation":"The integral on (a,b] minus the integral on (b,a], with the supplied measure.","effect_on_target":"Uses oriented integrals for arbitrary endpoint orders in space and time.","source_match":"Matches the selected rectangle balance; orientation consistently extends the ordinary ordered-interval formula.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D069","name":"AddCommGroup.toDivisionAddCommMonoid","interpretation":"Builds a commutative subtraction structure from the existing additive group.","effect_on_target":"Retains the same subtraction and negation in derivative infrastructure.","source_match":"No change to the real equations.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D070","name":"AddCommMagma.toAdd","interpretation":"Projects addition from a commutative additive structure.","effect_on_target":"Supplies addition in the generic advection balance.","source_match":"Instantiated by ordinary real addition.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D071","name":"AddCommMonoid.toAddCommSemigroup","interpretation":"Retains addition and commutativity while forgetting zero.","effect_on_target":"Part of the additive-instance path in the PDE predicate.","source_match":"Does not change real addition.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D072","name":"AddCommSemigroup.toAddCommMagma","interpretation":"Retains addition and its commutativity.","effect_on_target":"Routes generic addition to the existing real operation.","source_match":"Preserves the differential sum.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D073","name":"AddMonoid.toAddZeroClass","interpretation":"Retains zero, addition, and zero identities.","effect_on_target":"Supplies zero and scalar-action prerequisites.","source_match":"Matches the homogeneous right-hand side.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D074","name":"AddZero.toZero","interpretation":"Projects zero.","effect_on_target":"Supplies the zero used by scalar multiplication and derivative infrastructure.","source_match":"The instantiated zero is real zero.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D075","name":"AddZeroClass.toAddZero","interpretation":"Projects the addition-with-zero structure.","effect_on_target":"Preserves zero and addition along the derivative instance path.","source_match":"No alteration of the source equations.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D076","name":"DistribMulAction.toDistribSMul","interpretation":"Retains scalar action together with its distributivity and preservation of zero.","effect_on_target":"Supports the speed*qx term in the generic advection predicate.","source_match":"At Real this is ordinary multiplication by the wave speed.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D077","name":"DistribSMul.toSMulZeroClass","interpretation":"Projects the scalar action preserving zero.","effect_on_target":"Supplies derivative scalar-action infrastructure.","source_match":"Preserves ordinary real multiplication.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D078","name":"ENormedAddCommMonoid.toESeminormedAddCommMonoid","interpretation":"Forgets norm definiteness while retaining extended norm and addition.","effect_on_target":"Part of the integrability/additive-instance path.","source_match":"Does not change the actual real norm or introduce a zero seminorm.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D079","name":"ESeminormedAddCommMonoid.toAddCommMonoid","interpretation":"Retains addition, zero, and commutativity.","effect_on_target":"Supplies algebra for real-valued integral expressions.","source_match":"Matches ordinary real additive quantities.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D080","name":"ESeminormedAddCommMonoid.toESeminormedAddMonoid","interpretation":"Projects the extended-seminorm additive monoid.","effect_on_target":"Provides inherited algebra and norm for integration infrastructure.","source_match":"No change to real integrability.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D081","name":"ESeminormedAddMonoid.toAddMonoid","interpretation":"Projects the additive monoid.","effect_on_target":"Preserves addition and zero used in integral predicates.","source_match":"Matches real integral arithmetic.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D082","name":"Exists","interpretation":"Existential quantification over a witness satisfying a predicate.","effect_on_target":"Partial-derivative witnesses may depend on each space-time point.","source_match":"Matches local derivative existence; no globally constant derivative is imposed.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D083","name":"HSMul.hSMul","interpretation":"Projects the selected scalar action.","effect_on_target":"Forms speed acting on the spatial derivative.","source_match":"At Real it equals the source product -c*w²_x.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D084","name":"HasDerivAt","interpretation":"A derivative assertion at the ordinary neighborhood filter of a point, with that point as fixed base.","effect_on_target":"Requires genuine two-sided real derivatives of the time and space slices.","source_match":"Matches classical partial derivatives under the selected interpretation, with no derivative assigned to a nondifferentiable profile.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D085","name":"Module.toDistribMulAction","interpretation":"Projects the distributive scalar action of a module.","effect_on_target":"Connects real module multiplication to the advection derivative term.","source_match":"Matches scalar multiplication in the source PDE.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D086","name":"Ne","interpretation":"Negation of equality.","effect_on_target":"Requires density not equal to zero in the acoustic bundle.","source_match":"Redundant under selected rho>0 and consistent with 1/rho.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D087","name":"NegZeroClass.toZero","interpretation":"Projects the zero of a negation-with-zero structure.","effect_on_target":"Supplies the same zero in derivative algebra.","source_match":"Matches real zero.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D088","name":"NormedAddCommGroup.toAddCommGroup","interpretation":"Projects the underlying additive commutative group.","effect_on_target":"Provides the real additive structure for derivative values.","source_match":"Matches the real linear equations.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D089","name":"NormedAddCommGroup.toENormedAddCommMonoid","interpretation":"Builds the extended-norm commutative additive monoid using the inherited real norm.","effect_on_target":"Supports integrability while retaining the original addition and norm.","source_match":"Matches the selected absolute-integrability semantics.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D090","name":"Real.instMonoid","interpretation":"The inferred canonical real multiplicative monoid.","effect_on_target":"Supplies multiplication and identity for division and scalar action.","source_match":"Matches real coefficient arithmetic.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D091","name":"Real.semiring","interpretation":"The inferred canonical real semiring.","effect_on_target":"Supplies algebraic prerequisites for the real scalar module.","source_match":"Does not replace the real field with a restricted scalar type.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D092","name":"SMulZeroClass.toSMul","interpretation":"Projects scalar multiplication.","effect_on_target":"Selects the actual scalar action in HasDerivAt infrastructure.","source_match":"Matches real multiplication.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D093","name":"SubNegZeroMonoid.toNegZeroClass","interpretation":"Retains zero and negation, including negation of zero.","effect_on_target":"Supports the derivative predicate's additive algebra.","source_match":"Preserves ordinary real zero and negation.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D094","name":"SubtractionCommMonoid.toSubtractionMonoid","interpretation":"Projects the subtraction structure while forgetting commutativity.","effect_on_target":"Preserves subtraction along the derivative instance path.","source_match":"No change to real subtraction.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D095","name":"SubtractionMonoid.toSubNegZeroMonoid","interpretation":"Retains subtraction and negation and derives preservation of zero by negation.","effect_on_target":"Provides coherent zero and negation in derivative infrastructure.","source_match":"Matches ordinary real arithmetic.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D096","name":"instHSMul","interpretation":"Uses an existing scalar action as heterogeneous scalar multiplication.","effect_on_target":"Routes speed acting on qx to real scalar multiplication.","source_match":"Preserves the transport coefficient.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D097","name":"AddCommGroup.toAddCommMonoid","interpretation":"Retains addition, zero, and commutativity while forgetting inverses.","effect_on_target":"Supplies the underlying module's additive monoid.","source_match":"No change to the real fields.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D098","name":"AddCommGroup.toAddGroup","interpretation":"Projects the additive group.","effect_on_target":"Provides inverse and subtraction prerequisites for derivatives.","source_match":"Matches real additive operations.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D099","name":"ContinuousSMul","interpretation":"The external proposition that the scalar action is jointly continuous.","effect_on_target":"Discharged by D011 and D012 for the fixed real structures; not a profile regularity premise.","source_match":"Matches ordinary real calculus infrastructure.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D100","name":"DivisionSemiring.toSemiring","interpretation":"Projects the underlying semiring.","effect_on_target":"Supports the real scalar module without changing operations.","source_match":"Matches real coefficient arithmetic.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D101","name":"Field.toSemifield","interpretation":"Retains the field's semiring, inverse, division, and associated laws.","effect_on_target":"Part of the real scalar-instance path.","source_match":"No domain restriction or change of division.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D102","name":"Inv.inv","interpretation":"Projects inverse.","effect_on_target":"Forms the acoustic coefficient rho⁻¹.","source_match":"Equals 1/rho on the selected positive-density domain.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D103","name":"MonoidWithZero.toMonoid","interpretation":"Projects multiplication and its identity.","effect_on_target":"Supplies scalar-action prerequisites.","source_match":"Preserves real multiplication.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D104","name":"NontriviallyNormedField.toNormedField","interpretation":"Projects the normed field.","effect_on_target":"Preserves the real scalar norm and algebra for HasDerivAt.","source_match":"Matches ordinary real calculus.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D105","name":"NormedField.toField","interpretation":"Projects the underlying field.","effect_on_target":"Supplies real division and module algebra.","source_match":"Matches the source's real coefficients.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D106","name":"NormedField.toNormedSpace","interpretation":"Views a normed field as a normed space over itself, using its canonical module.","effect_on_target":"Supports real-valued acoustic derivative witnesses.","source_match":"Uses ordinary real multiplication as scalar action.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D107","name":"Real.instInv","interpretation":"The real reciprocal operation.","effect_on_target":"Determines the density inverse in (1.5).","source_match":"Matches reciprocal positive density; the exceptional zero case is excluded.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D108","name":"Semifield.toDivisionSemiring","interpretation":"Retains semiring operations, inverse, division, and their laws.","effect_on_target":"Provides the scalar algebra required by derivative definitions.","source_match":"No alteration of the real physical parameters.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D109","name":"Semiring.toMonoidWithZero","interpretation":"Retains multiplication, one, zero, and their laws.","effect_on_target":"Supports the module scalar-action instance.","source_match":"Preserves real multiplication and zero.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D110","name":"SubNegMonoid.toAddMonoid","interpretation":"Projects the underlying additive monoid.","effect_on_target":"Supplies addition and zero for derivative scalar actions.","source_match":"Matches ordinary real addition.","status":"pass"},
    {"id":"D111","name":"NormedField.toNormedCommRing","interpretation":"Retains norm, ring, and metric while forgetting field-specific structure.","effect_on_target":"Connects real scalar calculus to its ordinary metric.","source_match":"Preserves the real analytical setting.","status":"pass"},
